_readme: Per-device-type erase-sector spec used by hex_to_ota.py --batch. Key = device type (string, matches the firmware_hex/<type>/ folder name). Value = the --sectors string to use for every hex under that type (e.g. "5-6" or "2,5-15"). A type with no entry here (or an explicit null) defaults to full erase, same as an explicit "" — only list a type here if it needs a narrower, explicit sector list instead of that default. This is a per-device/per-bootloader safety decision (which sectors are safe to erase without touching settings/black-box data) — not something derivable from the hex file. See host/README.md's Firmware OTA section.
